title: Order a coffee
description: Order your drink and handle one quick follow-up.

greeting.translation: Hi! What would you like to drink?
greeting.hint: Start with “Quisiera…” to make a polite request.

choices.spanish: Un café con leche, por favor.
choices.translation: A coffee with milk, please.
choices.response: ¡Claro! ¿Lo quieres caliente o con hielo?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course! Would you like it hot or iced?

choices.translation: A black coffee, please.
choices.response: Perfecto. ¿Pequeño o grande?
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. Small or large?

choices.translation: Where is my room?
choices.response: Ah, buscas un café. ¿Qué te gustaría tomar?
choices.responseTranslation: Ah, you are looking for a coffee. What would you like?

temperature.translation: Do you prefer it hot or iced?
temperature.hint: “Caliente” means hot. “Con hielo” means with ice.

choices.translation: Hot, please.
choices.response: Enseguida. Son cuarenta y cinco pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Right away. That will be forty-five pesos.

choices.translation: Iced, thanks.
choices.response: Buena elección. Son cuarenta y cinco pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Good choice. That will be forty-five pesos.

choices.translation: Where is the bathroom?
choices.response: El baño está al fondo. ¿Y tu bebida?
choices.responseTranslation: The restroom is in the back. And your drink?

choices.translation: Small, please.
choices.response: Perfecto. Son cuarenta y cinco pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. That will be forty-five pesos.

choices.translation: Large, thanks.
choices.response: Claro que sí. Son cincuenta y cinco pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. That will be fifty-five pesos.

choices.translation: What time does the flight leave?
choices.response: Eso puedes preguntarlo en el aeropuerto. ¿Pequeño o grande?
choices.responseTranslation: You can ask that at the airport. Small or large?

title: Check into a hotel
description: Confirm a booking or ask for a room for tonight.

booking.translation: Good afternoon. Do you have a reservation?
booking.hint: “Sí, tengo una reservación” means “Yes, I have a reservation.”

choices.spanish: Sí, tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: Yes, I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Me muestra su identificación, por favor?
choices.responseTranslation: Great. Could you show me your ID, please?

choices.translation: No, do you have a room available?
choices.response: Sí, tenemos una habitación para esta noche.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, we have a room for tonight.

choices.translation: I would like a table for two.
choices.response: El restaurante está al lado. ¿Tiene una reservación aquí?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is next door. Do you have a reservation here?

id.prompt: ¿A nombre de quién está la reservación?
id.translation: What name is the reservation under?
id.hint: Say “A nombre de…” followed by your name.

choices.translation: Under Lee.
choices.response: Gracias. Su habitación está lista.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. Your room is ready.

choices.spanish: Me llamo Lee. Aquí está mi identificación.
choices.translation: My name is Lee. Here is my ID.
choices.response: Gracias, Lee. Su habitación está lista.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you, Lee. Your room is ready.

choices.translation: I want to order breakfast.
choices.correctionSpanish: A nombre de Lee, por favor.
choices.response: El desayuno empieza a las siete. ¿A nombre de quién?
choices.responseTranslation: Breakfast starts at seven. What name is it under?

available-room.hint: “Una noche” is one night. “Dos noches” is two nights.

choices.translation: For one night, please.
choices.response: Perfecto. ¿Me muestra su identificación?
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. Could you show me your ID?

choices.translation: For two nights. How much does it cost?
choices.response: Son mil doscientos pesos por noche.
choices.responseTranslation: It is twelve hundred pesos per night.

choices.translation: Where is the station?
choices.response: La estación está cerca. ¿Cuántas noches se queda?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is nearby. How many nights are you staying?

title: At the airport
description: Tell the driver where you are going and choose a ride.

destination.hint: Use “Voy a…” to say “I am going to…”

choices.translation: I am going to the hotel downtown.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Quiere un taxi o el autobús?
choices.responseTranslation: All right. Would you like a taxi or the bus?

choices.spanish: Voy al centro de la ciudad.
choices.translation: I am going to the city center.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Quiere un taxi o el autobús?
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. Would you like a taxi or the bus?

choices.translation: I would like a coffee with milk.
choices.response: Hay una cafetería adentro. ¿A dónde va?
choices.responseTranslation: There is a café inside. Where are you going?

ride.hint: “Prefiero el taxi” means “I prefer the taxi.”

choices.translation: I prefer the taxi, please.
choices.response: Muy bien. El taxi está aquí afuera.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. The taxi is right outside.

choices.spanish: El autobús, gracias. ¿Dónde está la parada?
choices.translation: The bus, thanks. Where is the stop?
choices.response: Está frente a la salida principal.
choices.responseTranslation: It is in front of the main exit.

choices.translation: Do you have a room available?
choices.response: El hotel está en el centro. ¿Taxi o autobús?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is downtown. Taxi or bus?

title: Ask for directions
description: Find a landmark and understand how to get there.

find-place.translation: Excuse me, are you looking for something?

choices.translation: Yes, I am looking for the museum.
choices.response: Está cerca. ¿Quiere ir a pie o en metro?
choices.responseTranslation: It is nearby. Would you like to walk or take the metro?

choices.translation: Where is the metro station?
choices.response: Está en la siguiente calle. ¿Va al museo?
choices.responseTranslation: It is on the next street. Are you going to the museum?

choices.translation: I would like a table for two.
choices.response: El restaurante está en la esquina. ¿Busca algo más?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is on the corner. Are you looking for something else?

how-to-go.prompt: ¿Prefiere ir a pie o en metro?
how-to-go.translation: Would you prefer to walk or take the metro?
how-to-go.hint: “A pie” means on foot. “En metro” means by metro.

choices.translation: On foot, thanks. Is it far?
choices.response: No, está a cinco minutos. Siga derecho.
choices.responseTranslation: No, it is five minutes away. Go straight ahead.

choices.translation: By metro, please.
choices.response: Tome la línea dos y baje en la siguiente estación.
choices.responseTranslation: Take line two and get off at the next station.

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.response: El hotel está a dos calles. ¿Prefiere caminar?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is two blocks away. Would you prefer to walk?

title: Meet your partner’s family
description: Make a warm first impression and join the conversation.

hello.translation: Hi! It is so nice to meet you.
hello.hint: “Mucho gusto” is a friendly way to say “Nice to meet you.”

choices.translation: Nice to meet you. I am Alex.
choices.response: ¿De dónde eres, Alex?
choices.responseTranslation: Where are you from, Alex?

choices.translation: Thank you for having me. I am Alex.
choices.response: ¿Cómo conociste a nuestra hija?
choices.responseTranslation: How did you meet our daughter?

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.response: El autobús sale pronto. Pero primero, ¡mucho gusto!
choices.responseTranslation: The bus leaves soon. But first, nice to meet you!

choices.translation: I am from Seattle. And you?
choices.response: Yo soy de Guadalajara. ¿Te gusta la comida mexicana?
choices.responseTranslation: I am from Guadalajara. Do you like Mexican food?

choices.translation: I am from the United States.
choices.response: ¡Qué bien! ¿Ya probaste los tacos?
choices.responseTranslation: How nice! Have you tried tacos yet?

choices.spanish: Quisiera una habitación para dos noches.
choices.translation: I would like a room for two nights.
choices.response: Aquí tenemos espacio para todos. ¿De dónde eres?
choices.responseTranslation: We have room for everyone here. Where are you from?

how-met.translation: How did you meet our daughter?

choices.translation: We met at work.
choices.response: ¡Qué bonita historia! ¿Te gusta vivir aquí?
choices.responseTranslation: What a lovely story! Do you like living here?

choices.spanish: Nos presentó una amiga en común.
choices.translation: A mutual friend introduced us.
choices.response: ¡Qué bien! Nos alegra mucho conocerte.
choices.responseTranslation: That is nice! We are very happy to meet you.

choices.translation: How much does the taxi cost?
choices.response: El taxi puede esperar. Cuéntame, ¿cómo se conocieron?
choices.responseTranslation: The taxi can wait. Tell me, how did you two meet?

title: Order tacos at a taquería
description: Order tacos, choose a filling, and ask for toppings.

order.translation: Hi there! What can I get you?
order.hint: “Me da…” is a natural, polite way to order.

choices.spanish: Me da tres tacos al pastor, por favor.
choices.translation: Three pastor tacos, please.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Con todo?
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. With everything on them?

choices.translation: What do you recommend?
choices.response: Los tacos de suadero son muy buenos. ¿Cuántos le doy?
choices.responseTranslation: The suadero tacos are very good. How many should I get you?

choices.translation: Do you have a room available?
choices.correctionSpanish: Me da tres tacos, por favor.
choices.response: Aquí no tenemos habitaciones, pero sí buenos tacos. ¿Cuántos quiere?
choices.responseTranslation: We do not have rooms here, but we do have good tacos. How many would you like?

choices.translation: Yes, with everything, thanks.
choices.response: Va. ¿Qué salsa le pongo?
choices.responseTranslation: You got it. Which salsa should I add?

choices.spanish: Con todo, pero sin cebolla, por favor.
choices.translation: With everything, but without onion, please.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Quiere salsa verde o roja?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Would you like green or red salsa?

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.response: La parada está cerca. ¿Le pongo todo a los tacos?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus stop is nearby. Should I put everything on the tacos?

quantity.translation: How many tacos should I get you?
quantity.hint: Use “dos” for two and “tres” for three.

choices.translation: Two, please.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Con cilantro y cebolla?
choices.responseTranslation: All right. With cilantro and onion?

choices.translation: Three, and one without onion.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Quiere salsa aparte?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Would you like salsa on the side?

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.response: Aquí no hace falta reservación. ¿Cuántos tacos le preparo?
choices.responseTranslation: You do not need a reservation here. How many tacos should I make?

choices.translation: Green salsa, please.
choices.response: Claro. Ahorita le preparo todo.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. I will get everything ready now.

choices.translation: Red salsa, but on the side, thanks.
choices.response: Perfecto. Aquí tiene.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. Here you go.

choices.translation: Where is the metro station?
choices.response: La estación está a dos calles. ¿Qué salsa quería?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is two blocks away. Which salsa did you want?

pay.prompt: Son setenta y cinco pesos. ¿Algo más?
pay.translation: That will be seventy-five pesos. Anything else?

choices.translation: No, that is all. Thanks.
choices.response: Gracias. ¡Buen provecho!
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. Enjoy your meal!

choices.spanish: ¿Me da también un agua, por favor?
choices.translation: Could I also have a bottled water, please?
choices.response: Sí, claro. Aquí tiene.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. Here you are.

choices.spanish: ¿Me puede dar la clave del wifi?
choices.translation: Could you give me the Wi-Fi password?
choices.response: El wifi está en el restaurante de al lado. ¿Va a llevar algo más?
choices.responseTranslation: The Wi-Fi is at the restaurant next door. Would you like anything else?

title: Get a table at a restaurant
description: Ask for a table and find out what is on the menu.

choices.spanish: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
choices.translation: A table for two, please.
choices.response: Con gusto. ¿Adentro o en la terraza?
choices.responseTranslation: Certainly. Inside or on the patio?

choices.translation: There are four of us. Do you have room?
choices.response: Sí, pasen. ¿Prefieren adentro o afuera?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, come on in. Would you prefer inside or outside?

choices.translation: How do I get to downtown?
choices.correctionSpanish: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
choices.response: El centro está a diez minutos. ¿Busca una mesa para cuántas personas?
choices.responseTranslation: Downtown is ten minutes away. How many people need a table?

seating.translation: Would you prefer inside or on the patio?

choices.translation: Inside, please.
choices.response: Por aquí. Enseguida les traigo el menú.
choices.responseTranslation: This way. I will bring you the menu in a moment.

choices.spanish: En la terraza, si se puede.
choices.translation: On the patio, if possible.
choices.response: Claro, sí hay una mesa disponible. Les traigo el menú.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, there is a table available. I will bring you the menu.

choices.translation: Do you have a room available?
choices.response: No tenemos habitaciones; el hotel está enfrente. ¿Prefiere una mesa adentro?
choices.responseTranslation: We do not have rooms; the hotel is across the street. Would you prefer a table inside?

menu.translation: Do you know what you are going to order?
menu.hint: “¿Qué me recomienda?” is a handy way to ask for a recommendation.

choices.translation: Not yet. What do you recommend?
choices.response: La sopa del día y el pescado están muy buenos.
choices.responseTranslation: The soup of the day and the fish are very good.

choices.spanish: Sí, para mí una enchilada de mole.
choices.translation: Yes, I will have an enchilada with mole.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Y para tomar?
choices.responseTranslation: All right. And something to drink?

choices.translation: How much is the ticket?
choices.response: Los boletos son para el museo. ¿Qué le gustaría pedir?
choices.responseTranslation: Tickets are for the museum. What would you like to order?

title: Ask for the bill
description: Finish a meal and ask whether you can pay by card.

bill.translation: Can I get you anything else?
bill.hint: In Mexico, “la cuenta” is the bill or check.

choices.translation: No, thanks. Could you bring me the bill?
choices.response: Claro, ahorita se la traigo.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, I will bring it right over.

choices.spanish: La cuenta, por favor. ¿Se puede dividir?
choices.translation: The bill, please. Can it be split?
choices.response: Sí, claro. ¿Cuántas cuentas serían?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. How many checks would that be?

choices.translation: I would like to order a room.
choices.response: Aquí no rentamos habitaciones. ¿Quiere la cuenta?
choices.responseTranslation: We do not rent rooms here. Would you like the bill?

payment.prompt: ¿Va a pagar en efectivo o con tarjeta?
payment.translation: Will you pay in cash or by card?
payment.hint: “Con tarjeta” means by card; “en efectivo” means in cash.

choices.translation: By card, please.
choices.response: Claro. Puede acercar la tarjeta aquí.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. You can tap your card here.

choices.translation: In cash. Do you accept pesos?
choices.response: Sí, claro. Son cuatrocientos veinte pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. That will be 420 pesos.

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.response: La terminal está cerca. ¿Va a pagar en efectivo o con tarjeta?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus terminal is nearby. Will you pay in cash or by card?

choices.translation: On two checks, please.
choices.response: Muy bien. Ahorita se las traigo.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. I will bring them right over.

choices.translation: One check is better. Thanks.
choices.response: Claro. Puede pagar aquí cuando guste.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. You can pay here whenever you are ready.

choices.spanish: ¿Tiene algo para el dolor de cabeza?
choices.translation: Do you have something for a headache?
choices.response: La farmacia está en la esquina. ¿Prefiere una cuenta o dos?
choices.responseTranslation: The pharmacy is on the corner. Would you prefer one check or two?

title: Shop for fruit at a market
description: Ask for ripe fruit, choose an amount, and check the price.

fruit.translation: What can I get for you?
fruit.hint: “Me da…” is a common, polite market request.

choices.spanish: ¿Me da un kilo de mangos, por favor?
choices.translation: Could I have a kilo of mangoes, please?
choices.response: Claro. ¿Los quiere maduros para hoy?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Do you want them ripe for today?

choices.translation: How much are the avocados?
choices.response: A sesenta pesos el kilo. ¿Cuánto le pongo?
choices.responseTranslation: Sixty pesos a kilo. How much should I give you?

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación para esta noche.
choices.translation: I have a reservation for tonight.
choices.correctionSpanish: Me da un kilo de mangos, por favor.
choices.response: Aquí vendemos fruta, no hay habitaciones. ¿Qué fruta busca?
choices.responseTranslation: We sell fruit here, not rooms. What fruit are you looking for?

ripeness.translation: Do you want them ripe for today?

choices.spanish: Sí, por favor. Que estén maduros.
choices.translation: Yes, please. Let them be ripe.
choices.response: Muy bien. Escojo unos buenos.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. I will pick out some good ones.

choices.spanish: Mejor unos que estén buenos para mañana.
choices.translation: Better ones that will be good for tomorrow.
choices.response: Claro, estos están un poquito más firmes.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure, these are a little firmer.

choices.translation: Where is the metro station?
choices.correctionSpanish: Que estén maduros para hoy, por favor.
choices.response: La estación está a tres calles. ¿Los mangos los quiere maduros?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is three blocks away. Do you want the mangoes ripe?

amount.translation: How much should I give you?

choices.translation: Half a kilo, please.
choices.response: Sí. Son treinta pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. That will be thirty pesos.

choices.translation: One kilo, thanks.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Algo más?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Anything else?

choices.translation: Where is the restroom?
choices.response: El baño está en el mercado, junto a la entrada. ¿Cuánto le pongo?
choices.responseTranslation: The restroom is in the market, by the entrance. How much should I give you?

title: Buy a long-distance bus ticket
description: Choose a destination and ask when the next bus leaves.

destination.translation: Good morning. Where are you traveling?

choices.spanish: Un boleto para Puebla, por favor.
choices.translation: One ticket to Puebla, please.
choices.response: ¿Para qué día y a qué hora?
choices.responseTranslation: For what day and time?

choices.translation: Do you have tickets to Querétaro today?
choices.response: Sí. ¿Prefiere salir en la mañana o en la tarde?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes. Would you rather leave in the morning or afternoon?

choices.spanish: Me da tres tacos al pastor.
choices.translation: Three pastor tacos, please.
choices.correctionSpanish: Un boleto para Puebla, por favor.
choices.response: La taquería está afuera. ¿A dónde quiere viajar?
choices.responseTranslation: The taco stand is outside. Where would you like to travel?

schedule.translation: What time would you like to leave?
schedule.hint: “Lo antes posible” means “as soon as possible.”

choices.spanish: En la mañana, si hay lugar.
choices.translation: In the morning, if there is a seat.
choices.response: Sí, hay uno a las nueve y media.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, there is one at 9:30.

choices.translation: The next one, please.
choices.response: Sale en cuarenta minutos, desde el andén cinco.
choices.responseTranslation: It leaves in forty minutes, from platform five.

choices.translation: I would like a coffee with milk.
choices.response: Hay café en la sala de espera. ¿A qué hora quiere viajar?
choices.responseTranslation: There is coffee in the waiting room. What time would you like to travel?

time.translation: Would leaving at two work for you?

choices.translation: Yes, perfect. How much is it?
choices.response: Son cuatrocientos ochenta pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: It is 480 pesos.

choices.translation: Is there one a little later?
choices.response: Sí, el siguiente sale a las cuatro.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, the next one leaves at four.

choices.translation: Nice to meet you. I am Alex.
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, me sirve salir a las dos.
choices.response: Mucho gusto, Alex. El autobús sale a las dos.
choices.responseTranslation: Nice to meet you, Alex. The bus leaves at two.

title: Get around on the metro
description: Ask about a transit card and find the right platform.

card.hint: “Una tarjeta de transporte” is a transit card.

choices.spanish: Quiero comprar una tarjeta de transporte.
choices.translation: I want to buy a transit card.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Cuántos viajes le cargo?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. How many rides should I load?

choices.translation: Where can I buy a card?
choices.response: En la taquilla de aquí. ¿Quiere que le ayude a cargarla?
choices.responseTranslation: At the ticket booth here. Would you like help loading it?

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill, please?
choices.correctionSpanish: Quiero una tarjeta de transporte, por favor.
choices.response: El restaurante está afuera. ¿Necesita una tarjeta para el metro?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is outside. Do you need a metro card?

load.translation: How much credit would you like to add?

choices.translation: One hundred pesos, please.
choices.response: Listo. Ya puede pasar por el torniquete.
choices.responseTranslation: Done. You can go through the turnstile now.

choices.spanish: Solo lo necesario para un viaje.
choices.translation: Just enough for one ride.
choices.response: Claro. Le cargo un viaje.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. I will load one ride.

choices.translation: How much does the taxi cost?
choices.correctionSpanish: Cien pesos de saldo, por favor.
choices.response: El taxi se toma en la calle. ¿Cuánto saldo le pongo a la tarjeta?
choices.responseTranslation: You can get a taxi on the street. How much credit should I put on the card?

platform.hint: “¿Qué dirección?” asks which direction to travel.

choices.translation: I am going downtown. Which direction should I take?
choices.response: Tome el tren en dirección a Universidad.
choices.responseTranslation: Take the train heading toward Universidad.

choices.spanish: Voy a la línea dos. ¿Por dónde paso?
choices.translation: I am going to line two. Which way do I go?
choices.response: Siga los letreros azules y baje las escaleras.
choices.responseTranslation: Follow the blue signs and go downstairs.

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.response: El hotel está fuera de la estación. ¿A dónde va?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is outside the station. Where are you going?

title: Agree on a taxi fare
description: Confirm the fare and tell the driver where to stop.

fare.hint: “¿Cuánto me cobra?” means “How much will you charge me?”

choices.spanish: Al centro, por favor. ¿Cuánto me cobra?
choices.translation: Downtown, please. How much will you charge me?
choices.response: Son ciento ochenta pesos, más o menos.
choices.responseTranslation: About 180 pesos.

choices.spanish: Al hotel de la avenida Juárez.
choices.translation: To the hotel on Juárez Avenue.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Tiene la dirección exacta?
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. Do you have the exact address?

choices.translation: What time does the museum close?
choices.response: El museo cierra a las seis. ¿A dónde lo llevo?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum closes at six. Where can I take you?

confirm.translation: Does that price work for you?
confirm.hint: A polite way to clarify is “¿Ese precio incluye…?”

choices.translation: Yes, that is fine. Thank you.
choices.response: Perfecto. Suba, por favor.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. Please get in.

choices.translation: Does that price include the luggage?
choices.response: Sí, no se preocupe. Está incluido.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, do not worry. It is included.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill?
choices.response: No hay cuenta, es el precio del viaje. ¿Le parece bien?
choices.responseTranslation: There is no bill; that is the fare. Does it work for you?

address.hint: Say “calle” for street and “número” for number.

choices.translation: At number 120.
choices.response: Entendido. Lo dejo en la entrada.
choices.responseTranslation: Got it. I will drop you at the entrance.

choices.spanish: No sé el número. Se lo muestro en el mapa.
choices.translation: I do not know the number. I will show you on the map.
choices.response: Sí, con eso está bien.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, that works.

choices.translation: I would like a table for two.
choices.correctionSpanish: Está en el número ciento veinte.
choices.response: El restaurante está por allá. ¿Cuál es la dirección del hotel?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is over there. What is the hotel address?

title: Take a city bus
description: Check the route, pay, and ask where to get off.

route.translation: Which route are you looking for?
route.hint: “¿Pasa por…?” asks whether the bus goes by a place.

choices.translation: Does this bus go by the market?
choices.response: Sí, pero tiene que bajarse en la avenida Hidalgo.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, but you need to get off at Hidalgo Avenue.

choices.translation: Does this bus go downtown?
choices.response: Sí, va hacia el centro. ¿Ya tiene cambio?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it heads downtown. Do you have exact change?

choices.spanish: Me da un café negro, por favor.
choices.translation: A black coffee, please.
choices.response: La cafetería está en la esquina. ¿A dónde necesita ir?
choices.responseTranslation: The café is on the corner. Where do you need to go?

fare.translation: Do you have change to pay?
fare.hint: “¿Cuánto cuesta el pasaje?” asks the fare.

choices.spanish: Sí, aquí tiene. ¿Cuánto cuesta el pasaje?
choices.translation: Yes, here you go. How much is the fare?
choices.response: Son diez pesos. Gracias.
choices.responseTranslation: It is ten pesos. Thank you.

choices.spanish: No tengo cambio. ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?
choices.translation: I do not have change. Can I pay by card?
choices.response: En esta ruta solo aceptan efectivo.
choices.responseTranslation: On this route, they only accept cash.

choices.translation: Do you have a room for tonight?
choices.response: El hotel está en la avenida. ¿Tiene cambio para el pasaje?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is on the avenue. Do you have change for the fare?

stop.hint: “Avíseme, por favor” means “Please let me know.”

choices.spanish: En el mercado. ¿Me avisa cuando lleguemos?
choices.translation: At the market. Could you let me know when we get there?
choices.response: Sí, claro. Se lo digo antes.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. I will tell you before we arrive.

choices.spanish: En la siguiente parada, por favor.
choices.translation: At the next stop, please.
choices.response: Claro, aquí es. Baje con cuidado.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, this is it. Step down carefully.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill?
choices.response: El restaurante está en la siguiente cuadra. ¿En dónde se baja?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is on the next block. Where are you getting off?

title: Check out of your hotel
description: Return your key and confirm the final bill.

checkout.prompt: Buenos días. ¿Va a hacer su salida?
checkout.translation: Good morning. Are you checking out?
checkout.hint: “Vengo a hacer el check-out” is also commonly understood.

choices.spanish: Sí, vengo a hacer el check-out.
choices.translation: Yes, I am here to check out.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Me entrega la llave, por favor?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Could you hand me the key?

choices.spanish: Sí. ¿Todavía puedo dejar mi maleta aquí?
choices.translation: Yes. Can I still leave my suitcase here?
choices.response: Sí, se la guardamos hasta la tarde.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, we can store it for you until this afternoon.

choices.translation: Do you have a table for two?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, vengo a hacer el check-out.
choices.response: El restaurante está en la planta baja. ¿Va a salir de su habitación?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is on the ground floor. Are you checking out of your room?

key.translation: Could you hand me the key?

choices.translation: Yes, here is the key.
choices.response: Gracias. ¿Todo estuvo bien durante su estancia?
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. Was everything all right during your stay?

choices.translation: I lost the key. Is there a charge?
choices.response: No se preocupe, vamos a revisar su cuenta.
choices.responseTranslation: Do not worry, we will check your bill.

choices.translation: Where can I buy a bus ticket?
choices.response: La terminal está a unas calles. ¿Me entrega la llave?
choices.responseTranslation: The terminal is a few blocks away. Could you hand me the key?

luggage.translation: What time will you pick it up?

choices.spanish: Como a las cuatro, por favor.
choices.translation: Around four, please.
choices.response: Perfecto. Le damos una ficha para recogerla.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. We will give you a claim ticket.

choices.spanish: En la tarde. ¿Hasta qué hora están?
choices.translation: This afternoon. How late are you open?
choices.response: Estamos hasta las diez de la noche.
choices.responseTranslation: We are open until ten at night.

choices.translation: Could I have two tacos, please?
choices.correctionSpanish: Como a las cuatro, por favor.
choices.response: La taquería está enfrente. ¿A qué hora recoge su maleta?
choices.responseTranslation: The taco stand is across the street. What time will you pick up your suitcase?

title: Ask for the Wi-Fi password
description: Ask how to connect and clarify the network name.

wifi.translation: Do you need help with anything?
wifi.hint: “La contraseña del wifi” means “the Wi-Fi password.”

choices.spanish: ¿Me puede dar la contraseña del wifi?
choices.translation: Could you give me the Wi-Fi password?
choices.response: Sí, claro. Está en la tarjeta de su habitación.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. It is on your room card.

choices.translation: How do I connect to the Wi-Fi?
choices.response: Conéctese a la red del hotel con su número de habitación.
choices.responseTranslation: Connect to the hotel network with your room number.

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.correctionSpanish: ¿Me puede dar la contraseña del wifi?
choices.response: Perfecto, señor Lee. ¿También necesita conectarse al wifi?
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect, Mr. Lee. Do you also need to connect to the Wi-Fi?

network.translation: Do you see the network name?
network.hint: “No aparece” means “It is not showing up.”

choices.translation: Yes, I found it. Thanks.
choices.response: Con gusto. Que tenga buena tarde.
choices.responseTranslation: You are welcome. Have a nice afternoon.

choices.spanish: No aparece. ¿Cómo se llama la red?
choices.translation: It is not showing up. What is the network called?
choices.response: Se llama Hotel Centro. La contraseña está en la tarjeta.
choices.responseTranslation: It is called Hotel Centro. The password is on the card.

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.correctionSpanish: No aparece la red. ¿Me ayuda a encontrarla?
choices.response: El autobús sale a las cinco. ¿No aparece la red del hotel?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus leaves at five. Is the hotel network not showing up?

title: Ask for help at a pharmacy
description: Describe a common symptom and ask how to use the medicine.

symptom.translation: Good afternoon. What do you need?

choices.spanish: Me duele la cabeza. ¿Tiene algo para eso?
choices.translation: I have a headache. Do you have something for that?
choices.response: Sí. ¿Es alérgico a algún medicamento?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes. Are you allergic to any medicine?

choices.spanish: Tengo dolor de estómago desde ayer.
choices.translation: I have had a stomachache since yesterday.
choices.response: Entiendo. ¿Ha tomado algún medicamento?
choices.responseTranslation: I see. Have you taken any medicine?

choices.translation: Do you have a room available?
choices.correctionSpanish: Me duele la cabeza. ¿Me puede ayudar?
choices.response: El hotel está a dos calles. ¿Qué le duele?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is two blocks away. What is hurting?

allergy.translation: Do you have any medicine allergies?
allergy.hint: “No que yo sepa” means “None that I know of.”

choices.translation: None that I know of.
choices.response: De acuerdo. Lea las indicaciones antes de tomarlo.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. Read the directions before taking it.

choices.spanish: Sí, soy alérgico a la penicilina.
choices.translation: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin.
choices.response: Gracias por avisarme. Voy a buscar otra opción.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you for letting me know. I will look for another option.

choices.translation: Where is the metro station?
choices.correctionSpanish: No tengo alergias que yo sepa.
choices.response: La estación está cerca. ¿Es alérgico a algún medicamento?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is nearby. Are you allergic to any medicine?

medicine.translation: Have you taken anything for the pain?

choices.translation: Not yet. How do I take this?
choices.response: Siga las indicaciones del empaque y consulte a un médico si empeora.
choices.responseTranslation: Follow the package directions and consult a doctor if it gets worse.

choices.spanish: Sí, pero no se me ha quitado.
choices.translation: Yes, but it has not gone away.
choices.response: Si continúa el dolor, es mejor consultar a un médico.
choices.responseTranslation: If the pain continues, it is best to consult a doctor.

choices.translation: What do you recommend for dinner?
choices.correctionSpanish: Todavía no he tomado nada para el dolor.
choices.response: El restaurante está al lado. ¿Ha tomado algo para el dolor?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is next door. Have you taken anything for the pain?

title: Describe a symptom at a clinic
description: Explain how you feel and answer a basic question at reception.

checkin.prompt: Buenos días. ¿Qué le trae por aquí?
checkin.translation: Good morning. What brings you in today?

choices.spanish: Tengo fiebre y me siento muy cansado.
choices.translation: I have a fever and feel very tired.
choices.response: Lo siento. ¿Desde cuándo se siente así?
choices.responseTranslation: I am sorry. How long have you felt this way?

choices.spanish: Tengo tos desde hace dos días.
choices.translation: I have had a cough for two days.
choices.response: Entiendo. ¿Tiene dificultad para respirar?
choices.responseTranslation: I see. Are you having trouble breathing?

choices.translation: I would like a coffee with milk.
choices.correctionSpanish: Me siento mal y necesito hablar con un médico.
choices.response: La cafetería está afuera. ¿Qué síntomas tiene?
choices.responseTranslation: The café is outside. What symptoms do you have?

duration.translation: How long have you had a fever?

choices.translation: Since yesterday afternoon.
choices.response: Gracias. El personal médico le atenderá pronto.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. The medical staff will see you soon.

choices.translation: Since last night. Can I wait here?
choices.response: Sí, tome asiento. Le avisamos cuando pase.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, have a seat. We will let you know when it is your turn.

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.correctionSpanish: Tengo fiebre desde ayer en la tarde.
choices.response: La parada está afuera. ¿Desde cuándo tiene fiebre?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus stop is outside. How long have you had a fever?

breathing.hint: “No, respiro bien” means “No, I can breathe fine.”

choices.translation: No, I can breathe fine. Thank you.
choices.response: De acuerdo. El médico le hará unas preguntas más.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. The doctor will ask you a few more questions.

choices.spanish: Sí, un poco. Necesito ayuda pronto.
choices.translation: Yes, a little. I need help soon.
choices.response: Voy a avisar al personal médico ahora.
choices.responseTranslation: I will alert the medical staff now.

choices.translation: How much is a kilo of mangoes?
choices.response: El mercado está enfrente. ¿Le cuesta trabajo respirar?
choices.responseTranslation: The market is across the street. Are you having trouble breathing?

title: Explain a food allergy
description: Tell restaurant staff about an allergy and check an ingredient.

allergy.translation: Do you know what you are going to order?
allergy.hint: “Soy alérgico a…” means “I am allergic to…”

choices.spanish: Antes de pedir, soy alérgico a los cacahuates.
choices.translation: Before ordering, I am allergic to peanuts.
choices.response: Gracias por avisarnos. ¿También le hacen daño las trazas?
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you for letting us know. Do traces cause a reaction too?

choices.spanish: No puedo comer mariscos; soy alérgica.
choices.translation: I cannot eat shellfish; I am allergic.
choices.response: Entiendo. Voy a confirmar qué platillos son seguros.
choices.responseTranslation: I understand. I will check which dishes are safe.

choices.translation: Do you have a room with a view?
choices.response: El hotel está en la esquina. ¿Tiene alguna alergia alimentaria?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is on the corner. Do you have a food allergy?

traces.translation: Do traces cause a reaction too?
traces.hint: “Sí, por favor tenga mucho cuidado” is clear and polite.

choices.spanish: Sí, por favor. Necesito evitar cualquier contacto.
choices.translation: Yes, please. I need to avoid any contact.
choices.response: Entendido. Se lo voy a indicar a la cocina.
choices.responseTranslation: Understood. I will let the kitchen know.

choices.spanish: No, las trazas no me afectan.
choices.translation: No, traces do not affect me.
choices.response: Gracias. Voy a confirmar los ingredientes.
choices.responseTranslation: Thanks. I will confirm the ingredients.

choices.translation: Where is the museum?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, también me afectan las trazas.
choices.response: El museo está a dos calles. ¿Las trazas también le hacen daño?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum is two blocks away. Do traces also cause a reaction?

safe.prompt: ¿Le gustaría que le recomendara algo sin mariscos?
safe.translation: Would you like me to recommend something without shellfish?
safe.hint: “¿Este platillo lleva…?” means “Does this dish contain…?”

choices.spanish: Sí, por favor. ¿Qué platillo es seguro?
choices.translation: Yes, please. Which dish is safe?
choices.response: El pollo asado no lleva mariscos. Voy a revisar que no haya contacto.
choices.responseTranslation: The roast chicken does not contain shellfish. I will check for cross-contact.

choices.translation: Does this rice contain shrimp?
choices.response: Déjeme confirmarlo con la cocina.
choices.responseTranslation: Let me check with the kitchen.

choices.translation: Does this bus go downtown?
choices.correctionSpanish: ¿Qué platillo me recomienda que no lleve mariscos?
choices.response: Sí, va al centro. ¿Quiere que le recomiende un platillo sin mariscos?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it goes downtown. Would you like me to recommend a dish without shellfish?

title: Find a restroom
description: Ask where the restroom is and whether it is for customers.

ask.translation: Can I help you with anything?
ask.hint: “¿Dónde está el baño?” is a simple, polite question.

choices.translation: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
choices.response: Al fondo, a la derecha.
choices.responseTranslation: At the back, on the right.

choices.translation: Is there a restroom I can use?
choices.response: Sí, está junto a la cocina.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it is next to the kitchen.

choices.translation: Do you have a room for two?
choices.response: El hotel está enfrente. El baño está al fondo.
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is across the street. The restroom is at the back.

access.hint: “¿Tengo que pedir algo?” asks if you need to order something.

choices.translation: Do I have to buy something to use it?
choices.response: No, no se preocupe. Puede pasar.
choices.responseTranslation: No, do not worry. You can go ahead.

choices.translation: I understand. Thank you for letting me know.
choices.response: De nada. Está al fondo.
choices.responseTranslation: You are welcome. It is at the back.

choices.translation: How much will you charge me to go downtown?
choices.response: El centro está a ciento ochenta pesos. ¿Busca el baño?
choices.responseTranslation: Downtown is 180 pesos. Are you looking for the restroom?

title: Get a local SIM card
description: Ask for a data plan and check what you need to activate it.

plan.translation: What kind of plan are you looking for?

choices.spanish: Busco un plan con datos para una semana.
choices.translation: I am looking for a plan with data for a week.
choices.response: Tenemos uno con cinco gigas. ¿Su teléfono está desbloqueado?
choices.responseTranslation: We have one with five gigabytes. Is your phone unlocked?

choices.spanish: Quiero comprar una tarjeta SIM local.
choices.translation: I want to buy a local SIM card.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Su teléfono acepta una SIM física?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Does your phone take a physical SIM?

choices.translation: How much is a kilo of avocados?
choices.correctionSpanish: Busco una tarjeta SIM con datos.
choices.response: El mercado está en la otra calle. ¿Busca una tarjeta SIM?
choices.responseTranslation: The market is on the next street. Are you looking for a SIM card?

choices.translation: Yes, it is unlocked.
choices.response: Perfecto. ¿Me muestra una identificación?
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. Could you show me an ID?

choices.translation: I am not sure. How can I check?
choices.response: Podemos revisar la configuración del teléfono.
choices.responseTranslation: We can check the phone settings.

choices.translation: Does this bus go through downtown?
choices.response: Sí, pasa por el centro. ¿Su teléfono está desbloqueado?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it goes through downtown. Is your phone unlocked?

id.hint: “Aquí está mi pasaporte” means “Here is my passport.”

choices.translation: Yes, here is my passport.
choices.response: Gracias. El plan cuesta doscientos pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. The plan costs 200 pesos.

choices.translation: Yes. Does the price include activation?
choices.response: Sí, incluye la tarjeta y la activación.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it includes the SIM and activation.

choices.translation: Nice to meet you. I am Alex.
choices.response: Mucho gusto, Alex. ¿Tiene una identificación para activar la línea?
choices.responseTranslation: Nice to meet you, Alex. Do you have an ID to activate the line?

title: Drop off laundry
description: Ask when clothes will be ready and mention a delicate item.

dropoff.translation: Good morning. What service do you need?
dropoff.hint: “Lavar esta ropa” means to wash these clothes.

choices.spanish: Quiero lavar esta ropa, por favor.
choices.translation: I would like to have these clothes washed, please.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Para cuándo las necesita?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. When do you need them?

choices.spanish: Quiero lavar esta ropa. ¿Pueden lavar esta blusa a mano?
choices.translation: I want to wash these clothes. Can you hand wash this blouse?
choices.response: Claro. ¿Hay alguna otra prenda delicada?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Are there any other delicate items?

choices.translation: A black coffee, please.
choices.correctionSpanish: Quiero lavar esta ropa, por favor.
choices.response: La cafetería está a la vuelta. ¿Quiere lavar ropa?
choices.responseTranslation: The café is around the corner. Do you want to have clothes washed?

ready.hint: “Para mañana en la tarde” means tomorrow afternoon.

choices.spanish: Para mañana en la tarde, si se puede.
choices.translation: By tomorrow afternoon, if possible.
choices.response: Sí, estarán listas después de las cuatro.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, they will be ready after four.

choices.translation: Can they be ready today?
choices.response: Sí, pero el servicio exprés cuesta un poco más.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, but express service costs a little more.

choices.translation: What time does the museum close?
choices.response: El museo cierra a las seis. ¿Para cuándo necesita la ropa?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum closes at six. When do you need your clothes?

delicate.translation: Are any of the items delicate?
delicate.hint: “Lavar a mano” means to hand wash.

choices.spanish: Sí, esta falda también es delicada.
choices.translation: Yes, this skirt is delicate too.
choices.response: Entendido. La separamos del resto.
choices.responseTranslation: Understood. We will separate it from the rest.

choices.translation: No, just the blouse. Thanks.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Necesita algo más?
choices.responseTranslation: All right. Do you need anything else?

choices.translation: Where is the station?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, esta blusa se tiene que lavar a mano.
choices.response: La estación está cerca. ¿Hay alguna prenda delicada?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is nearby. Are any of the items delicate?

title: Buy a museum ticket
description: Ask about admission and check whether a student discount applies.

ticket.translation: Good morning. How many tickets do you need?
ticket.hint: “Un boleto para adulto” is one adult ticket.

choices.spanish: Un boleto para adulto, por favor.
choices.translation: One adult ticket, please.
choices.response: Claro. ¿Desea una audioguía?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Would you like an audio guide?

choices.spanish: Dos boletos, por favor. ¿Hay descuento para estudiantes?
choices.translation: Two tickets, please. Is there a student discount?
choices.response: Sí, con credencial vigente.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, with a current student ID.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill, please?
choices.correctionSpanish: Un boleto para adulto, por favor.
choices.response: El restaurante está en la salida. ¿Cuántos boletos necesita?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is by the exit. How many tickets do you need?

guide.translation: Would you like to add an audio guide?
guide.hint: “Por ahora no, gracias” means “Not for now, thanks.”

choices.spanish: Sí, por favor. ¿Está también en inglés?
choices.translation: Yes, please. Is it also in English?
choices.response: Sí, puede elegir el idioma al comenzar.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, you can choose the language when you start.

choices.translation: Not for now, thanks.
choices.response: De acuerdo. La exposición empieza a la izquierda.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. The exhibit starts on the left.

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, quiero una audioguía, por favor.
choices.response: La terminal está cerca. ¿Quiere agregar una audioguía?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus terminal is nearby. Would you like to add an audio guide?

discount.translation: Do you have your student ID?

choices.translation: Yes, here it is.
choices.response: Gracias. Con el descuento son sesenta pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. With the discount, it is sixty pesos.

choices.spanish: No la traigo. ¿Puedo pagar el precio normal?
choices.translation: I do not have it with me. Can I pay the regular price?
choices.response: Sí, claro. La entrada general cuesta cien pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. General admission is 100 pesos.

choices.translation: I am looking for a local SIM card.
choices.response: La tienda de teléfonos está afuera. ¿Trae su credencial?
choices.responseTranslation: The phone shop is outside. Do you have your ID?

title: Join a guided tour
description: Find out when the tour starts and ask about its language.

tour.translation: Are you looking for information about the tours?
tour.hint: “¿A qué hora empieza?” asks what time it starts.

choices.spanish: Sí. ¿A qué hora empieza el próximo recorrido?
choices.translation: Yes. What time does the next tour start?
choices.response: Empieza a las once, frente a la entrada.
choices.responseTranslation: It starts at eleven, in front of the entrance.

choices.spanish: Quiero reservar un lugar para el recorrido.
choices.translation: I want to reserve a spot on the tour.
choices.response: Con gusto. ¿Para cuántas personas?
choices.responseTranslation: Certainly. For how many people?

choices.translation: How much is a taxi downtown?
choices.correctionSpanish: Quiero información sobre el próximo recorrido.
choices.response: El taxi al centro cuesta unos ciento ochenta pesos. ¿Busca un recorrido?
choices.responseTranslation: A taxi downtown costs about 180 pesos. Are you looking for a tour?

language.translation: What language would you prefer for the tour?
language.hint: “¿Hay uno en inglés?” asks if one is available in English.

choices.translation: In Spanish, please.
choices.response: Perfecto. Puede comprar su boleto aquí.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. You can buy your ticket here.

choices.translation: Is there one in English?
choices.response: Sí, el de las doce es en inglés.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, the noon tour is in English.

choices.translation: How much is a kilo of mangoes?
choices.response: Los mangos cuestan cuarenta pesos. ¿En qué idioma quiere el recorrido?
choices.responseTranslation: The mangoes cost forty pesos. What language do you want for the tour?

group.hint: “Somos tres” means “There are three of us.”

choices.translation: There are three of us.
choices.response: Muy bien. Quedan tres lugares para el recorrido de la una.
choices.responseTranslation: All right. There are three spots left on the one o’clock tour.

choices.translation: Just me. Is there still room?
choices.response: Sí, todavía hay un lugar disponible.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, there is still one spot available.

choices.spanish: Tengo tos desde hace dos días.
choices.translation: I have had a cough for two days.
choices.response: La clínica está enfrente. ¿Cuántas personas vienen al recorrido?
choices.responseTranslation: The clinic is across the street. How many people are coming on the tour?

title: Report a lost phone
description: Explain where you last saw your phone and share a description.

lost.hint: “Perdí mi teléfono” means “I lost my phone.”

choices.translation: I lost my phone. Can you help me?
choices.response: Claro. ¿Dónde lo vio por última vez?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. Where did you last see it?

choices.spanish: Creo que dejé mi teléfono en el café.
choices.translation: I think I left my phone at the café.
choices.response: Vamos a llamar al café. ¿Cómo es su teléfono?
choices.responseTranslation: Let us call the café. What does your phone look like?

choices.spanish: Me da un café con leche.
choices.translation: A coffee with milk, please.
choices.correctionSpanish: Perdí mi teléfono y necesito ayuda.
choices.response: La cafetería está a la vuelta. ¿Perdió algo?
choices.responseTranslation: The café is around the corner. Did you lose something?

where.translation: Where did you last see it?

choices.spanish: En el autobús, hace como una hora.
choices.translation: On the bus, about an hour ago.
choices.response: ¿Recuerda la ruta o el número del autobús?
choices.responseTranslation: Do you remember the bus route or number?

choices.spanish: En una mesa del café de la plaza.
choices.translation: On a table at the café in the plaza.
choices.response: Vamos a comunicarnos con ellos. ¿Cómo es?
choices.responseTranslation: We will contact them. What does it look like?

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill?
choices.correctionSpanish: Lo vi por última vez en el café de la plaza.
choices.response: El café está junto al restaurante. ¿Dónde lo vio por última vez?
choices.responseTranslation: The café is next to the restaurant. Where did you last see it?

describe.hint: “Tiene una funda…” means “It has a case…”

choices.spanish: Es negro y tiene una funda azul.
choices.translation: It is black and has a blue case.
choices.response: Gracias. Voy a preguntar en objetos perdidos.
choices.responseTranslation: Thanks. I will ask at lost and found.

choices.spanish: Es rojo. Puedo mostrarle una foto.
choices.translation: It is red. I can show you a picture.
choices.response: Sí, por favor. Eso puede ayudar.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, please. That could help.

choices.translation: Where is the station?
choices.correctionSpanish: Es negro y tiene una funda azul.
choices.response: La estación está a tres calles. ¿De qué color es su teléfono?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is three blocks away. What color is your phone?

route.translation: Do you remember which route you took?
route.hint: “No recuerdo el número” means “I do not remember the number.”

choices.spanish: Sí, creo que era la ruta cuatro.
choices.translation: Yes, I think it was route four.
choices.response: Voy a llamar a la terminal para preguntar.
choices.responseTranslation: I will call the terminal to ask.

choices.spanish: No recuerdo el número, pero iba al centro.
choices.translation: I do not remember the number, but it was going downtown.
choices.response: Entiendo. Voy a consultar con objetos perdidos.
choices.responseTranslation: I see. I will check with lost and found.

choices.translation: What time does the museum close?
choices.correctionSpanish: Creo que era la ruta cuatro.
choices.response: El museo cierra a las seis. ¿Recuerda qué ruta tomó?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum closes at six. Do you remember which route you took?

title: Find missing luggage
description: Report a bag that did not arrive and give its identifying details.

luggage.translation: Are you having a problem with your luggage?
luggage.hint: “No llegó mi maleta” means “My suitcase did not arrive.”

choices.spanish: No llegó mi maleta. ¿Dónde hago el reporte?
choices.translation: My suitcase did not arrive. Where do I file a report?
choices.response: En el mostrador de equipaje. ¿Tiene su comprobante?
choices.responseTranslation: At the baggage desk. Do you have your claim tag?

choices.spanish: Esta maleta no es mía. Busco una azul.
choices.translation: This suitcase is not mine. I am looking for a blue one.
choices.response: Entiendo. ¿Puede describirla?
choices.responseTranslation: I understand. Can you describe it?

choices.translation: Do you have a room for tonight?
choices.correctionSpanish: No llegó mi maleta. Necesito reportarla.
choices.response: El hotel está en el centro. El mostrador de equipaje está allá.
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is downtown. The baggage desk is over there.

tag.translation: Do you have your baggage claim tag?

choices.translation: Yes, here it is.
choices.response: Gracias. ¿Me da una descripción de la maleta?
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. Can you describe the suitcase?

choices.spanish: No lo encuentro, pero tengo una foto.
choices.translation: I cannot find it, but I have a photo.
choices.response: La foto también puede servir. ¿De qué color es?
choices.responseTranslation: The photo may work too. What color is it?

choices.translation: How much is a taxi downtown?
choices.response: El taxi cuesta ciento ochenta pesos. ¿Tiene el comprobante de equipaje?
choices.responseTranslation: The taxi costs 180 pesos. Do you have your baggage claim tag?

describe.translation: What does your suitcase look like?
describe.hint: Add a color and a detail to make the description clear.

choices.spanish: Es azul oscuro y tiene una etiqueta roja.
choices.translation: It is dark blue and has a red tag.
choices.response: Perfecto. Vamos a buscarla y le avisamos.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. We will look for it and let you know.

choices.spanish: Es negra, grande y tiene ruedas.
choices.translation: It is black, large, and has wheels.
choices.response: Gracias. ¿Qué número de teléfono podemos usar?
choices.responseTranslation: Thanks. What phone number can we use?

choices.spanish: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
choices.translation: A table for two, please.
choices.correctionSpanish: Es azul oscuro y tiene una etiqueta roja.
choices.response: El restaurante está junto a la salida. ¿Cómo es su maleta?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is next to the exit. What does your suitcase look like?

title: Greet a neighbor
description: Introduce yourself and make friendly conversation nearby.

hello.translation: Hi! I do not think we have met.
hello.hint: “Soy su nueva vecina” means “I am your new neighbor.”

choices.spanish: Mucho gusto. Soy Sam, la nueva vecina.
choices.translation: Nice to meet you. I am Sam, the new neighbor.
choices.response: ¡Mucho gusto, Sam! ¿Acaba de mudarse?
choices.responseTranslation: Nice to meet you, Sam! Did you just move in?

choices.spanish: Hola, me llamo Sam. ¿Usted vive aquí?
choices.translation: Hi, my name is Sam. Do you live here?
choices.response: Sí, vivo en el departamento de al lado.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, I live in the apartment next door.

choices.spanish: Tengo una reservación a nombre de Lee.
choices.translation: I have a reservation under Lee.
choices.correctionSpanish: Mucho gusto. Soy Sam, su nueva vecina.
choices.response: El hotel está en la esquina. ¿Acaba de mudarse por aquí?
choices.responseTranslation: The hotel is on the corner. Did you just move into the neighborhood?

choices.spanish: Sí, la semana pasada. Todavía estoy desempacando.
choices.translation: Yes, last week. I am still unpacking.
choices.response: ¡Bienvenida! Si necesita algo, aquí estoy.
choices.responseTranslation: Welcome! If you need anything, I am here.

choices.spanish: Hace unos meses, pero apenas salgo a conocer.
choices.translation: A few months ago, but I am just starting to explore.
choices.response: Pues bienvenida al barrio. Hay un mercado cerca.
choices.responseTranslation: Well, welcome to the neighborhood. There is a market nearby.

choices.translation: What time does the bus leave?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, me mudé la semana pasada.
choices.response: La parada está afuera. ¿Se mudó hace poco?
choices.responseTranslation: The bus stop is outside. Did you move in recently?

place.translation: Which apartment do you live in?

choices.translation: In number four, right across from you.
choices.response: ¡Ah, ya sé cuál! Qué gusto tenerla aquí.
choices.responseTranslation: Oh, I know which one! It is nice to have you here.

choices.spanish: En el edificio de al lado.
choices.translation: In the building next door.
choices.response: Qué bien. Si necesita una recomendación, dígame.
choices.responseTranslation: Great. If you need a recommendation, let me know.

choices.spanish: ¿Tiene algo para el dolor de cabeza?
choices.translation: Do you have something for a headache?
choices.correctionSpanish: Vivo en el departamento cuatro, enfrente.
choices.response: La farmacia está en la esquina. ¿En qué departamento vive?
choices.responseTranslation: The pharmacy is on the corner. Which apartment do you live in?

title: Make plans with a friend
description: Suggest a time and agree on a place to meet.

invite.prompt: ¿Te gustaría salir este fin de semana?
invite.translation: Would you like to go out this weekend?
invite.hint: “¡Sí, me encantaría!” means “Yes, I would love to!”

choices.translation: Yes, I would love to! What do you have in mind?
choices.response: Podríamos ir al mercado el sábado.
choices.responseTranslation: We could go to the market on Saturday.

choices.translation: Sure. Would you like to get coffee?
choices.response: ¡Buena idea! ¿Qué día te queda bien?
choices.responseTranslation: Good idea! What day works for you?

choices.translation: What time does the flight leave?
choices.correctionSpanish: ¡Sí, me gustaría salir! ¿Qué día tienes en mente?
choices.response: El vuelo sale a las tres. ¿Te gustaría salir este fin de semana?
choices.responseTranslation: The flight leaves at three. Would you like to go out this weekend?

day.hint: “Me queda mejor el domingo” means “Sunday works better for me.”

choices.spanish: Sí, el sábado me queda perfecto.
choices.translation: Yes, Saturday works perfectly for me.
choices.response: ¡Genial! ¿A qué hora nos vemos?
choices.responseTranslation: Great! What time should we meet?

choices.translation: Sunday works better for me. Can you make it?
choices.response: Sí, también puedo el domingo.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, I can do Sunday too.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill, please?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, el sábado me queda perfecto.
choices.response: El restaurante cierra a las diez. ¿Te queda bien el sábado?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant closes at ten. Does Saturday work for you?

choices.translation: At six, does that work for you?
choices.response: Perfecto. Nos vemos en la entrada.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. See you at the entrance.

choices.translation: Can we meet at five?
choices.response: Claro. Te mando la ubicación.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure. I will send you the location.

choices.translation: What time does the museum close?
choices.response: El museo cierra a las seis. ¿A qué hora nos vemos?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum closes at six. What time should we meet?

title: Turn down an invitation politely
description: Decline kindly and suggest another time if you want to.

invitation.prompt: ¿Quieres venir a cenar con nosotros hoy?
invitation.translation: Would you like to come have dinner with us today?
invitation.hint: “Gracias por invitarme” means “Thanks for inviting me.”

choices.spanish: Gracias por invitarme, pero hoy no puedo.
choices.translation: Thanks for inviting me, but I cannot today.
choices.response: No te preocupes. ¿Otro día?
choices.responseTranslation: No worries. Another day?

choices.spanish: Qué amable, pero hoy prefiero descansar.
choices.translation: That is kind of you, but I would rather rest today.
choices.response: Claro, que descanses. Nos vemos pronto.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, get some rest. See you soon.

choices.spanish: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
choices.translation: A table for two, please.
choices.correctionSpanish: Gracias por invitarme, pero hoy no puedo.
choices.response: El restaurante está enfrente. ¿Te gustaría venir a cenar?
choices.responseTranslation: The restaurant is across the street. Would you like to come to dinner?

choices.spanish: La próxima semana me viene mejor.
choices.translation: Next week works better for me.
choices.response: Perfecto. Te escribo para ponernos de acuerdo.
choices.responseTranslation: Perfect. I will text you so we can decide.

choices.translation: How about next Saturday?
choices.response: ¡Claro! Nos ponemos de acuerdo más cerca del día.
choices.responseTranslation: Sure! We will decide closer to the day.

choices.translation: I have had a fever since yesterday.
choices.correctionSpanish: La próxima semana me viene mejor.
choices.response: Lo siento. ¿Te sentirías mejor para la próxima semana?
choices.responseTranslation: I am sorry. Would next week work better for you?

title: Ask someone to repeat themselves
description: Ask someone to speak more slowly and confirm what you heard.

repeat.translation: Did you understand what I said?

choices.translation: Sorry, could you repeat that, please?
choices.response: Sí, claro. ¿A qué hora nos vemos?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, of course. What time should we meet?

choices.translation: Sorry, I did not understand everything.
choices.response: No se preocupe. Se lo explico otra vez.
choices.responseTranslation: Do not worry. I will explain it again.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill?
choices.response: Claro, le traigo la cuenta. ¿Necesita que repita algo?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, I will bring the bill. Do you need me to repeat anything?

slower.translation: Would you like me to speak more slowly?
slower.hint: “Sí, un poco más despacio” is polite and clear.

choices.spanish: Sí, por favor. Un poco más despacio.
choices.translation: Yes, please. A little more slowly.
choices.response: Claro. La cita es a las seis de la tarde.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. The appointment is at six in the evening.

choices.translation: No, thanks. This pace is fine.
choices.response: Muy bien. ¿Tiene alguna otra pregunta?
choices.responseTranslation: All right. Do you have any other questions?

choices.translation: Where is the station?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, por favor, un poco más despacio.
choices.response: La estación está a dos calles. ¿Quiere que hable más despacio?
choices.responseTranslation: The station is two blocks away. Would you like me to speak more slowly?

confirm.translation: What time should we meet, then?
confirm.hint: Repeat the time back to confirm you heard it correctly.

choices.spanish: A las seis de la tarde, ¿verdad?
choices.translation: At six in the evening, right?
choices.response: Exactamente. Nos vemos a las seis.
choices.responseTranslation: Exactly. See you at six.

choices.spanish: A las seis. ¿En dónde nos vemos?
choices.translation: At six. Where should we meet?
choices.response: En la entrada principal.
choices.responseTranslation: At the main entrance.

choices.translation: Do you have something for a cough?
choices.correctionSpanish: ¿Nos vemos a las seis de la tarde?
choices.response: La farmacia está al lado. ¿A qué hora nos vemos?
choices.responseTranslation: The pharmacy is next door. What time should we meet?

title: Plan a beach activity
description: Ask about an activity, its price, and when to meet.

activity.translation: Are you interested in doing an activity?
activity.hint: “¿Hay paseos en lancha?” asks about boat trips.

choices.translation: Are there boat trips this morning?
choices.response: Sí. El próximo sale a las diez.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes. The next one leaves at ten.

choices.translation: Can I rent snorkeling equipment?
choices.response: Sí. Incluye máscara y chaleco.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes. It includes a mask and a life vest.

choices.translation: What time does the museum close?
choices.response: El museo cierra a las seis. ¿Le interesa hacer algo en la playa?
choices.responseTranslation: The museum closes at six. Are you interested in doing something at the beach?

price.hint: “¿Cuánto cuesta por persona?” asks for the price per person.

choices.translation: There are two of us. How much is it per person?
choices.response: Son cuatrocientos pesos por persona.
choices.responseTranslation: It is 400 pesos per person.

choices.translation: Just me. Is there room?
choices.response: Sí, todavía queda un lugar.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, there is still one spot.

choices.translation: Does this bus go downtown?
choices.response: Sí, va al centro. ¿Cuántas personas van a la actividad?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, it goes downtown. How many people are going on the activity?

rental.translation: How long would you like to rent it?

choices.translation: For one hour, please.
choices.response: Claro. Necesito una identificación como depósito.
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. I need an ID as a deposit.

choices.translation: How much does it cost to rent for half a day?
choices.response: Cuesta trescientos pesos por medio día.
choices.responseTranslation: It costs 300 pesos for half a day.

choices.translation: When will my clothes be ready?
choices.response: La lavandería está en el pueblo. ¿Por cuánto tiempo quiere rentar el equipo?
choices.responseTranslation: The laundry is in town. How long would you like to rent the equipment?

time.prompt: ¿Le parece bien salir a las diez?
time.translation: Does leaving at ten work for you?
time.hint: “¿Dónde nos reunimos?” asks where to meet.

choices.translation: Yes. Where do we meet?
choices.response: Aquí, junto al letrero azul.
choices.responseTranslation: Here, by the blue sign.

choices.translation: Could it be at eleven?
choices.response: Sí, hay otro paseo a las once.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, there is another trip at eleven.

choices.translation: Could you bring me the bill?
choices.correctionSpanish: Sí, a las diez está bien.
choices.response: Claro, ahorita le traigo la cuenta. ¿Le parece bien salir a las diez?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course, I will bring the bill right over. Does leaving at ten work for you?

deposit.translation: Do you have an ID you can leave?
deposit.hint: “Sí, aquí está mi identificación” means “Yes, here is my ID.”

choices.translation: Yes, here is my ID.
choices.response: Gracias. Le devuelvo su identificación cuando regrese el equipo.
choices.responseTranslation: Thank you. I will return your ID when you bring back the equipment.

choices.translation: Can I leave a cash deposit?
choices.response: Sí, también puede dejar quinientos pesos.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, you can also leave 500 pesos.

choices.translation: Where is downtown?
choices.response: El centro está cerca. ¿Tiene una identificación para la renta?
choices.responseTranslation: Downtown is nearby. Do you have an ID for the rental?

title: Say hello and ask how someone is
description: Greet someone, ask how they are, and say goodbye.

hello.hint: Answer with a greeting, then ask “¿Cómo está?”

choices.translation: Good morning. How are you?
choices.response: Muy bien, gracias. ¿Y usted?
choices.responseTranslation: Very well, thanks. And you?

choices.translation: Hello. How are you?
choices.response: Bien, gracias. ¿Y usted?
choices.responseTranslation: Fine, thanks. And you?

choices.translation: See you later.
choices.response: ¡Espere! Apenas nos saludamos. ¿Cómo está?
choices.responseTranslation: Wait! We only just said hello. How are you?

how-are-you.translation: And you, how are you today?

choices.translation: Fine, thanks.
choices.response: Me alegro. Que tenga buen día.
choices.responseTranslation: I am glad. Have a good day.

choices.translation: So-so.
choices.response: Espero que mejore su día.
choices.responseTranslation: I hope your day gets better.

choices.translation: How much is it?
choices.response: No estoy vendiendo nada. Le pregunté cómo está.
choices.responseTranslation: I am not selling anything. I asked how you are.

goodbye.hint: Say goodbye back with “Adiós” or “Hasta luego.”

choices.translation: Goodbye. Take care.
choices.response: Igualmente. ¡Hasta luego!
choices.responseTranslation: You too. See you later!

choices.translation: See you later.
choices.response: ¡Hasta luego!
choices.responseTranslation: See you later!

choices.translation: Good morning.
choices.response: Eso es para saludar. Para despedirse, diga “hasta luego”.
choices.responseTranslation: That is for saying hello. To say goodbye, say “hasta luego.”

title: Introduce yourself
description: Share your name and where you are from with someone new.

name.prompt: Hola, me llamo Sofía. ¿Cómo te llamas?
name.translation: Hi, my name is Sofía. What is your name?
name.hint: Use “Me llamo…” to share your name.

choices.translation: My name is Alex. Nice to meet you.
choices.response: Mucho gusto, Alex. ¿De dónde eres?
choices.responseTranslation: Nice to meet you, Alex. Where are you from?

choices.translation: I am Alex.
choices.response: Encantada, Alex. ¿De dónde eres?
choices.responseTranslation: Pleased to meet you, Alex. Where are you from?

choices.translation: I am from the United States.
choices.response: Qué bien, pero ¿cómo te llamas?
choices.responseTranslation: How nice, but what is your name?

from.hint: Use “Soy de…” followed by a place.

choices.translation: I am from the United States.
choices.response: ¡Qué bien! ¿Y por qué estudias español?
choices.responseTranslation: How nice! And why are you studying Spanish?

choices.translation: I am from Chicago.
choices.response: ¡Qué interesante! ¿Y por qué estudias español?
choices.responseTranslation: How interesting! And why are you studying Spanish?

choices.translation: My name is Alex.
choices.response: Sí, ya lo sé. Te pregunté de dónde eres. ¿Por qué estudias español?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, I know. I asked where you are from. Why are you studying Spanish?

choices.translation: Because I like to travel.
choices.response: ¡Qué bien! Hablas muy bien.
choices.responseTranslation: How great! You speak very well.

choices.translation: Because I have family in Mexico.
choices.response: ¡Qué bonito! Hablas muy bien.
choices.responseTranslation: How lovely! You speak very well.

choices.translation: Yes, thanks.
choices.response: De nada, pero ¿por qué? Puedes empezar con “porque”.
choices.responseTranslation: You are welcome, but why? You can start with “porque.”

title: Buy a shirt
description: Ask about the price and size, then pay at a clothing shop.

welcome.prompt: Buenas tardes. ¿Le puedo ayudar en algo?
welcome.translation: Good afternoon. Can I help you with anything?

choices.translation: How much is this shirt?
choices.response: Cuesta trescientos pesos. ¿Qué talla busca?
choices.responseTranslation: It costs 300 pesos. What size are you looking for?

choices.translation: I am just looking, thanks.
choices.response: Claro. Esta camisa está en oferta. ¿Qué talla usa?
choices.responseTranslation: Of course. This shirt is on sale. What size do you wear?

choices.translation: A coffee, please.
choices.response: Aquí vendemos ropa, no café. ¿Qué talla busca?
choices.responseTranslation: We sell clothes here, not coffee. What size are you looking for?

choices.translation: Medium size, please.
choices.response: Aquí tiene. ¿Se la quiere probar?
choices.responseTranslation: Here you go. Would you like to try it on?

choices.translation: Can I try it on?
choices.response: Sí, los probadores están al fondo. ¿Le queda bien?
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, the fitting rooms are in the back. Does it fit?

choices.translation: You are welcome.
choices.response: Perdón, necesito saber su talla. Aquí tiene una mediana.
choices.responseTranslation: Sorry, I need to know your size. Here is a medium.

decide.hint: “Me la llevo” means “I will take it.”

choices.translation: Yes, I will take it. Do you take cards?
choices.response: Sí, aceptamos tarjeta. Gracias por su compra.
choices.responseTranslation: Yes, we take cards. Thanks for your purchase.

choices.translation: No, thanks. It is very expensive.
choices.response: No se preocupe. Gracias por venir.
choices.responseTranslation: No problem. Thanks for coming in.

choices.translation: Good morning.
choices.response: Buenos días. ¿Entonces se lleva la camisa?
choices.responseTranslation: Good morning. So will you take the shirt?
